test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - Quant (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A running track is comprised of a rectangular shape with semicircles at each of its shorter ends. The combined area of the two semicircles is 50% of the area of the central rectangular section. What is the approximate ratio of the length of the rectangular section to its width? (Use pi approx 3.14)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of 2 semicircles = Area of 1 circle = π × (W/2)² = πW²/4.

Given: Area of circle = 50% × Area of rectangle ⇒ πW²/4 = 0.5 × L × W.

Simplify: πW/4 = 0.5L ⇒ L/W = π / (4 × 0.5) = 3.14 / 2 = 1.57.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.57 : 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rectangular length = L | Rectangular width = W

Diameter of semicircles = W ⇒ Radius (r) = W/2

Area of 2 semicircles = 0.50 × Area of rectangle

**Formula Used:**

Area of circle = πr² | Area of rectangle = L × W

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c7eda8b9ed0b90a0f80a5c1c6eed91fd45538e8533b1f6a0e46ebb445dad97c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of 2 semicircles = π × (W/2)² = πW²/4

⇒ Area of rectangle = L × W

⇒ πW²/4 = 0.50 × (L × W)

⇒ πW/4 = 0.50L

⇒ L/W = π / (4 × 0.50)

⇒ L/W = 3.14 / 2

⇒ L/W = 1.57

**∴ The correct answer is 1.57 : 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perimeter of the Track

The total distance around the track is given by 2L + πW, where L is the straight length and W is the width.

Area of Circle and Semicircle

Area of a circle is πr² and the area of a semicircle is (πr²)/2. Two identical semicircles form one full circle.

Ratio and Proportion

A ratio compares two quantities. If L/W = 1.57, it means for every 1 unit of width, the length is 1.57 units.
